We will show in sequence some figures that describe different situations. Imagine that your own child has witnessed situations similar to those described by the figures. In these circumstances, your child has heard about a disability, and, not knowing the meaning of the term, asks: 'What is disability?' For each of the possible explanations, please indicate on a 5-point scale anchored at 1, I would never; 3, I might; or 5, I'm very likely to give a similar explanation.
item_text: We all are more or less disabled; No one is completely disabled or completely able-bodied. There are, rather, different ways of functioning.
